entry.title: Old Iron Earns More: A Technical Look at RustChain Proof-of-Antiquity
entry.summary:
Old Iron Earns More: A Technical Look at RustChain's Proof-of-Antiquity
Why I'm Writing This
I came across RustChain while looking at experimental consensus mechanisms. The pitch is unusual: a blockchain where a 2003 PowerBook G4 earns 2.5x more mining rewards than a modern AMD Threadripper. Not because it's faster — because it's older and provably real. I dug into the source code to understand whether this is a genuine novelty or another crypto gimmick. This is what I found. RustChain's consensus, called Proof-of-Antiquity (PoA), replaces hash-rate competition with hardware identity. Instead of "more compute = more reward," the system rewards hardware diversity and longevity. The principle is simple: a machine that has survived 20 years is rarer and more interesting than a ra…

entry.summary: Pi Coding Agent is a minimal, open-source terminal coding harness that ships with four default tools and leaves most of the behaviour to extensions, skills and your own workflow. Most AI coding agents are becoming bigger products. entry.title: Simple Healthy Habits for People Who Work at a Computer
entry.summary:
No matter if you are a developer, designer, writer, student, office worker, freelance worker, or home worker, it becomes hard to develop healthy habits while spending several hours looking at the computer. Take Breaks While Moving Take a walk for a few minutes after a lot of time spent sitting. Move your legs, shoulders, and back muscles to help your body to move during work. Drink Water Keep a bottle of water close to the computer and drink enough water to be well hydrated. It will help your body function normally and will help you to stay fresh. Have Good Posture Have good posture when working: sit with back supported, relaxed shoulders, and feet in the right position. Keep the computer in a suitable position not to bend your neck all the time.
Give Rest to Your Eyes Take breaks to look around and relax your eyes, not just the screen. Change the screen's brightness and font size to help your eyes see better.

entry.summary: An agent can fail because it missed the right material. It can also fail because I gave it the wrong material with confidence.
